about_1: I have a full-stack background and a curiosity for different areas of development, which helps me understand products from a broader perspective. However, my professional focus is on frontend logic, where I enjoy building functional interfaces, managing state, solving complex problems, and turning requirements into solid and scalable experiences
about_2: I adapt quickly to new challenges, changing environments, and different ways of working while maintaining a positive and solution-oriented mindset. Having lived in different countries and cities has allowed me to connect with people, perspectives, and dynamics different from my own. I consider myself a flexible, understanding, and communicative person, qualities that help me integrate and collaborate in diverse environments
about_3: I enjoy working in teams and value environments where well-being, collaboration, and work-life balance are part of everyday work. I believe good communication and healthy relationships contribute to a space where people feel comfortable, can be themselves, and work better together. That’s why, beyond contributing from a technical perspective, I also enjoy building meaningful connections within the team
about_4: I’m motivated by working on purposeful projects and contributing to solutions that create real value. I enjoy being involved in products that solve concrete problems, improve experiences, or make everyday life easier for people, regardless of the industry or scale of the project.
